title: Stable-ASR Turn And Full-Duplex Reference Collections
description: Curated upstream turn-taking, endpointing, full-duplex, and voice-agent evaluation projects that Stable-ASR should interoperate with or benchmark against. This registry is a planning and attribution aid; it does not vendor upstream code.

entries.name: Smart Turn
entries.focus: Native-audio turn completion detection for voice agents.
entries.reference_use: Use as an audio-only external turn detector baseline and prediction-export target.

entries.name: Easy Turn
entries.focus: Acoustic and linguistic four-state turn-taking prediction for full-duplex spoken dialogue.
entries.reference_use: Use as a multimodal complete, incomplete, backchannel, and wait baseline.

entries.name: Full-Duplex-Bench
entries.focus: Benchmark scenarios for pause handling, backchanneling, interruptions, side conversations, ambient speech, and real-time full-duplex evaluation.
entries.reference_use: Use as a benchmark-design reference for VoiceWorld scenario coverage and overlap handling.

entries.name: Voice Activity Projection
entries.focus: Self-supervised future voice activity prediction for turn-taking.
entries.reference_use: Use as a continuous turn-prediction objective and external prediction-template target.

entries.name: Pipecat
entries.focus: Realtime voice-agent orchestration and pipeline framework.
entries.reference_use: Use as an integration reference for VAD, Smart Turn, ASR, TTS, interruption, and transport boundaries.

entries.name: Silero VAD
entries.focus: Lightweight voice activity detection used in many realtime speech systems.
entries.reference_use: Use as a VAD reference for pause-threshold endpointing baselines and false-barge-in analysis.

entries.name: WebRTC VAD
entries.focus: Classic WebRTC voice activity detection exposed through Python bindings.
entries.reference_use: Use as a traditional VAD endpointing reference and low-dependency realtime baseline.
